metadata.title: Our Oracle Stock Pick Is Down, but Stabilizing. Buy More.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Our Oracle Stock Pick Is Down, But Stabilizing. Buy More.
The company’s recent results paint a picture of a business positioning itself to generate cash for shareholders.
A lot has happened with Oracle Corp., our stock pick from March. This is a moment to buy more shares.
